# noderings_instant_app (Data Source)

Looks up an Instant App (a one-click application image) by its slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_instant_app" "wordpress" {
  slug = "wordpress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug, for example `wordpress`.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (List of String) Categories.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `distro` (String) Operating system the app installs on, for example `ubuntu_24_04`.
- `documentation_url` (String) Documentation link.
- `family` (String) Application family.
- `id` (String) Instant App ID.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Recommended minimum disk in GB.
- `min_ram_gb` (Number) Recommended minimum memory in GB.
- `min_vcpus` (Number) Recommended minimum vCPUs.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `version` (String) Application version.
